rows.verdict_le10: and the sanctimony and staginess of overwrought addiction melodramas.
rows.dek_lead: An effort to capture how things really are, The Spectacular Now is an earnest coming-of-age film that avoids the glib reflexes symptomatic of the genre, and the sanctimony and staginess of overwrought addiction melodramas.
